answer: Bind each identity's bond to a hardware root rather than a key file, and cut the bond 25% for every claim that fails cross-check; a machine that lost its sealed root cannot repost the same deposit under a new label. A 1,000-account farm then needs 1,000 distinct roots at 500 POA each, so 500k POA sits on the wharf before one task ships, while an honest operator posts a single root and keeps earning through the tide. Each unverified claim chips the same deposit, and that thinning is the pigment that marks a farm.
